failed_gate: global_soak_zero_missing_and_zero_late_units: Tokyo and Sydney lost 564 UDP epochs at two distributors and delivered late LL-HLS parts after the cache-mesh contiguous-watermark defect; London and New York passed
revision_notes: av-mesh resolves playlists at pinned revision 516b838, not the workspace HEAD
daw-test-source was built without --locked against workspace soundkit 0.13.3; the probe resolves soundkit 0.12.3
all runs before gapfix-* used unmodified av-mesh; gapfix-* runs used the uncommitted branch cache-mesh-gap-skip
source_material: Lori Asha WESTSIDE_MIX 4 CONFIRMATION_130323.wav, 48 kHz 24-bit stereo, lossless FLAC in 5 ms units; DAW runs add SoundKit Opus

qualified_settings.relay_source_ports: selected per public link by one-way delay

cache_mesh_watermark_defect.summary: one unrecoverable part at a distributor stops its cache-mesh push until the hole leaves the ring (window_parts x 4 = 9600 parts = 48 s), then the backlog is sent in one tick

findings.zero_ppm_loss_seed_unsafe: with path_loss_ppm 0 the LL-HLS object lane has no repair; 2% primary-lane loss stops LL-HLS (loss-relay-2pct)
findings.shared_cpu_variance: three us-east Nanodes ran at 684-813 MB/s single-thread SHA-256 against a fleet median near 1500 MB/s with zero reported steal, then recovered within 20 minutes

nanode_limits.contributor_udp_mem_limit: net.ipv4.udp_mem scales with memory; a 1 GB host drops at 8 tracks

findings.opus_probe_validation: every SoundKit Opus part arrived in order but failed the probe packet check; soundkit 0.12.3 probe against a 0.13.3 source; Opus integrity is not qualified
findings.aggregated_responses: exploratory only; 100 ms responses with synchronized reader arrival had missing parts and 249-845 ms availability p99
